en.title: Muse Spark 1.3 Released: Enhanced Long Agent Tasks and Coding Efficiency
en.hook: Muse Spark 1.3 boosts long-horizon autonomous AI agent execution and code generation efficiency.
key_takeaways: Significantly improved stability and reasoning for long-running autonomous agent tasks.
Enhanced context retention and precision during complex coding and refactoring.
Optimized token efficiency and response latency tailored for developer workflows.

zh.title: Muse Spark 1.3 发布：提升长流程 Agent 任务与编程效率
